claims.label: Host Says SUBTT (Falcon 7X) Was Tracked Into U.S. Cities in 2022-2025, Repeatedly Landing Near TPUSA / TPUSA Faith / Charlie Kirk Events
claims.claim: The host says Flightradar tracking data she presents shows the Egyptian-registered Falcon 7X tail number SUBTT making multiple U.S. arrivals between 2022 and September 2025 in locations including St. Louis, Kansas, Lincoln (NE), Wichita, and Provo, in temporal proximity to TPUSA, TPUSA Faith, or Charlie Kirk events.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull official Flightradar / ADS-B archives for SUBTT across the cited dates; verify whether route and timing correlate with documented TPUSA / TPUSA Faith events as claimed.

claims.label: Host Says SUBND (Gulfstream 4) Was Tracked Into U.S. Cities in 2023-2025 With a Pattern of Extended Stays and Post-Event Departures
claims.claim: The host says Flightradar tracking data she presents shows the Egyptian-registered Gulfstream 4 tail number SUBND arriving in St. Louis on February 21, 2023 (remaining until May), arriving in Provo on April 19, 2024, arriving in Provo on May 23, 2025, and departing Provo on September 13, 2025 via Canada and Paris back to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Flightradar archive for SUBND on each cited date; cross-reference ground-time anomalies with TPUSA / TPUSA Faith event timing.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy promoted to TPUSA Chief of Staff on January 3, 2024
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy was promoted to Chief of Staff of Turning Point USA on January 3, 2024, saying she has the internal TPUSA email and so it is a fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the referenced internal TPUSA email through open-source verification or insider corroboration; cross-check TPUSA organizational filings and HR records.

claims.label: TPUSA UNL Chapter Launch Display Date Conflict Between Host Assertion (February 2024) and Producer Correction (May 2025)
claims.claim: The episode displays a TPUSA UNL Instagram post announcing the chapter's first weekly meeting; the host initially dates this to February 11, 2024, while director Mark later corrects the date to May 2025, as the host relays. Both assertions are recorded as competing host-side positions against a single artifact.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-examine the original Instagram post metadata (post date, capture date) to resolve the dating discrepancy between host and producer.

claims.label: Sean Feucht publicly accused of fraud, embezzlement, and financial mismanagement by multiple organizations in June 2025
claims.claim: The episode references a June 2025 article documenting multiple organizational allegations against Sean Feucht, including use of business credit cards for personal expenses, diversion of donations to personal accounts, inflated vendor payments, ministry funds used to rent his personal Montana cabin for board meetings, and ownership of multiple high-value properties.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the cited article directly; confirm each enumerated allegation against underlying source documents and any subsequent legal filings.

claims.label: SUBND May 23, 2025 Provo Arrival Described by Host as Possible Maintenance Stop
claims.claim: The host says the May 23, 2025 Provo arrival of SUBND appeared to be a "legitimate maintenance stop" based on test-flying activity around that time, adding "I don't know for certain".
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against FAA / airport maintenance logs whether a documented maintenance event is associated with the SUBND arrival.

claims.label: SUBTT Arrived in Provo on September 4, 2025 as a "Full Plane"
claims.claim: The episode presents that SUBTT landed in Provo on September 4, 2025 at 12:46 PM and that, per a "person overseas who had intimate knowledge," the plane was full on arrival.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Provo airport manifest or charter operator records; locate and contact the referenced overseas source for further detail.

claims.label: Host Says SUBND Departed Provo on September 13, 2025 via Canada, Paris, and Cairo
claims.claim: The host says the SUBND plane left Provo on September 13, 2025, three days after Charlie Kirk's assassination, routing through Canada and Paris back to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Flightradar archives; obtain Canadian / French ATC transit records and Cairo arrival logs to identify passengers.

claims.label: Tail Number of One Egyptian Plane Was Googled from Israel on September 8, 2025
claims.claim: The host states that the tail number of one of the planes, which she believes is the blue plane, was Googled from Israel on September 8, 2025, two days before the assassination, in response to a live-chat comment suggesting Google Trends correlation.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Google Trends / search-source attribution whether the cited tail-number search spike from Israeli IP ranges on September 8, 2025 is reproducible.

claims.label: Host Says N102DZ Flew Scottsdale to Salt Lake City at 7:12 AM on Day of Assassination
claims.claim: The host says N102DZ (G5 private jet) departed Scottsdale for Salt Lake City at 7:12 AM local time on the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination and landed at 9:23 AM local.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Flightradar / FAA archives for N102DZ on September 10, 2025; identify operator and registered owner; cross-reference with Scottsdale and Salt Lake City airport logs.

claims.label: Host Says N102DZ Left Salt Lake City Around 1:00 PM on Day of Assassination, Then Turned Around After 15 Minutes in Scottsdale
claims.claim: The host says N102DZ left Salt Lake City and headed to Scottsdale at about 1:00 PM local on September 10, 2025, was on the ground in Scottsdale for only about 15 minutes, and then turned around and flew out again.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the second-leg flight path; cross-check with Flightradar archives and FAA tracks.

claims.label: Host Says Borderline Bar and Grill Shooting Occurred November 7, 2018 in Thousand Oaks, CA, Killing 11 Patrons Plus Shooter
claims.claim: The host says that on November 7, 2018 a former Marine machine gunner opened fire at the Borderline Bar and Grill in Thousand Oaks, CA, killing 11 patrons and himself, and that the victims included other Marines and veterans.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm event details against contemporaneous news coverage; verify any documented role of Rob McCoy as pastor to the shooter's family.

claims.label: Netanyahu Publicly Stated He Invited Charlie Kirk to Israel Approximately Two Weeks Before Assassination
claims.claim: The episode reports that Israeli Prime Minister Bibi Netanyahu publicly stated he had called Charlie Kirk approximately two weeks before the assassination and invited him to Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the cited Netanyahu public statement (interview, press conference, or social-media post) and verify exact wording and date.

claims.label: Host Says News Story Reports Plumber Found 500 Envelopes of Cash at Joel Osteen's Megachurch
claims.claim: The host says a news story she brings up reports that a plumber repairing a toilet at Joel Osteen's megachurch found about 500 envelopes of cash in a wall (she first recalls almost a million dollars), and she characterizes Osteen's excuse as saying the church had money missing.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the underlying news article; verify the exact amount, date, and Osteen's official response.

claims.label: Host Says Tucker Carlson Gave a Speech at TPUSA Conference on July 11, 2025 Addressing Epstein, Israel, and Foreign Military Service
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson delivered a speech at the TPUSA conference on July 11, 2025 in which he referenced Jeffrey Epstein, said people who serve in foreign armies should probably have their citizenship stripped, "something along those lines," and mused on Bill Ackman's wealth.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Tucker Carlson TPUSA July 11, 2025 speech (video / transcript) and verify each cited claim against his actual statements.

claims.label: TPUSA Donor Confrontation with Charlie Kirk Immediately Following Tucker Carlson July 11, 2025 Speech
claims.claim: The host says she knows for a fact that when Tucker came off stage after his July 11, 2025 speech, a woman donor she has not named instantly started yelling at Charlie, and that Charlie then got the full donor squeeze: "you are not allowed to be anti-Israel."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate first-person testimony, contemporaneous social-media posts, or insider accounts corroborating the immediate post-speech confrontation.

claims.label: Live-Chat Comment Reports Charlie Kirk Did Fly into Salt Lake City for a "Restaurantology Summit" Interview
claims.claim: The host paraphrases an unattributed live-chat comment reporting that Charlie Kirk did in fact fly into Salt Lake City on September 10, 2025 for an interview with "Restaurantology Summit," and accepts the comment as resolving the N102DZ SLC mystery.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify existence of a Charlie Kirk "Restaurantology Summit" interview; cross-check with N102DZ passenger manifest if obtainable.

claims.label: Host Asserts Netanyahu Offered to Fund TPUSA and Andrew Kolvet Can Confirm
claims.claim: The host states that Netanyahu invited Charlie to Israel and Charlie declined, that Netanyahu offered to "fund Turning Point to the next level," and that Andrew Kolvet should be able to confirm the offer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct confirmation from Andrew Kolvet (public statement, interview, or testimony) corroborating the funding-offer claim.

claims.label: Host Asserts Charlie Kirk Did Not Know the Source of TPUSA Funding and Created DOGE to Trace It
claims.claim: The host states it is true that Charlie Kirk did not know where the money was coming from or going to, and that this is why he established DOGE.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate any direct statement from Charlie Kirk regarding TPUSA funding opacity; verify the DOGE organizational structure and stated mission.

claims.label: Live-Chat Critics Condemn TPUSA-Affiliated Pastors and Christian Zionist Silence After Charlie Kirk Assassination
claims.claim: The episode reads aloud live-chat comments, one voicing support for the host because 'the Zionists want to call you vermin', and one saying Pastor Jack Hibbs has not said nearly enough and condemning Christian Zionist loyalty replacing loyalty to "God, the church, and the truth."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify each named pastor / figure's public silence or statements in the period following September 10, 2025.

claims.label: Sean Feucht and Rob McCoy Reportedly Planning "Courageous Christianity Tour" Honoring Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Live-chat comment "Tim Morgan" states that Sean Feucht and Pastor McCoy are planning a "Courageous Christianity Tour" to honor Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the existence and details of any announced "Courageous Christianity Tour" through TPUSA Faith announcements, ticketing sites, or insider confirmations.

claims.label: NAR (New Apostolic Reformation) Research Connection to TPUSA Faith Leadership
claims.claim: The host says Sean Feucht's biography says he grew up in a New Apostolic Reformation (NAR) church, and that X user Village Crazy Lady told her to look into NAR, saying something is going on if you start talking about Rob McCoy; the host says NAR is somehow going to be relevant, noting it is an early phase of the investigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull and analyze Village Crazy Lady's pinned NAR research thread; cross-check Sean Feucht's biographical and ministry affiliations against NAR church networks and apostle affiliations.

claims.label: Sub-Claim: Host Asserts Rob McCoy Identified as Charlie Kirk's Pastor
claims.claim: The host states that Rob McCoy was in Nashville when the trans shooting happened and was close to Charlie Kirk when he was shot, that he says "I was his pastor," and that she says McCoy has terrible luck, adding she does not mean he shot anybody.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate any public statement by Rob McCoy identifying himself as Charlie Kirk's pastor; verify the nature and duration of any pastoral relationship.

claims.label: Host says people around Charlie Kirk are lying about where he was on his faith journey
claims.claim: The host says that, instead of acting as expected after the assassination, people around Charlie Kirk are making videos about her and lying about where he was on his faith journey, keeping his Catholic interest "hush-hush".
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA and family statements on Charlie Kirk's faith against the host's messages with him and other accounts of his Catholic interest.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're lying to you about where Charlie was on his faith journey.

claims.label: Host identifies show community as Decentralized Intelligence Agency
claims.claim: The host says the answer to the centralized intelligence agency is the decentralized intelligence agency, and that people must decentralize themselves to plug out of what she calls an utterly demonic system.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...ized intelligence agency, as we have said, is the decentralized intelligence agency. We must decentralize ourselves to plug out of this utterly demonic system. Anyway, what happened y...

claims.label: Host Says Irrefutable Proof of Foreign Actors Is Coming in This Episode
claims.claim: The host says she thinks that after this episode viewers will recognize there is irrefutable proof that foreign actors were involved in the assassination, which she says implies the government knows.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the proof the host presents later in the episode (flight data, tips) against independent records; the claim is only testable through what she later shows.
claims.transcript_snippet: Think after this episode you were going to recognize that there is just irrefutable proof that there were, in fact, foreign actors involved.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Was Taken Out by Something Bigger Than TPUSA and Robinson Never Set Foot on Campus
claims.claim: The host says she is confident Charlie Kirk was taken out by something much bigger than Turning Point USA and much bigger than Tyler Robinson, who she says she does not think even set foot on the campus that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Review UVU campus access logs, camera footage and the charging documents on how and when Robinson reached the campus.
claims.transcript_snippet: certainly much bigger than Tyler Robinson on the Loews rooftop, who I don't even think was even even set foot on the campus that day.

claims.label: Host Says Emails Claiming Kirk Is Alive Reflect TPUSA's Lack of Drive to Find the Killer
claims.claim: The host says she has received many emails from people convinced Charlie Kirk is still alive and attributes this to the lack of emotion and drive coming out of Turning Point USA to figure out who killed him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA's public statements and funded actions on the investigation against the host's characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're actually reacting to the lack of emotion and the lack of drive that is coming out of Turning Point USA to figure out who killed him.

claims.label: Host Recaps That the Egyptian Military Plane Departed the Morning of the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says she had tweeted about the Egyptian military plane, recognizing that it was not normal that it had departed on the morning of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ADS-B departure record for SUBTT from Provo on September 10, 2025 and its local departure time.
claims.transcript_snippet: obviously recognizing that it was not normal that this military Egyptian military plane had departed on the morning of Charlie's assassination.

claims.label: Host Admits She First Mistook the Plane's Departure for the Afternoon and Says the Debunk Was Wrong
claims.claim: The host says she made the mistake of thinking the Egyptian plane departed in the afternoon, that a critic's correction then trended as 'Egyptian plane debunked', and that it was not debunked.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's original tweet, the correcting post and the Flightradar time-zone display for SUBTT on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, I made the mistake of thinking it had departed in the afternoon

claims.label: Host's Foreign Source Says About 18 Arrived on the Plane and Far Fewer Left
claims.claim: The host says a foreigner told her the people who came in on the plane were not the people who went out, estimating roughly 18 people on the arriving flight and far fewer on the return.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain passenger and crew declarations for the SUBTT arrival and departure at Provo, and identify the overseas source through the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were estimating like approximately 18 people were on the plane that came over and far less were on the way back.

claims.label: Host Says a Live Commenter and Her Check Show SUBTT Was in Utah a Year Earlier With Kirk
claims.claim: The host says a live commenter told her SUBTT had been in Utah a year earlier at the same time as Charlie Kirk, and that when she checked it was true.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Flightradar archive for SUBTT in April 2024 and Kirk's April 2024 Utah schedule to confirm the overlap.
claims.transcript_snippet: that plane was in Utah at the same time as Charlie Kirk.
